chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 260 – Opera: A Night at the Theater Turns Strange
chapter_meta_description: A rival opera troupe arrives in the village. Li Huowang is dragged to watch, but he quickly senses that this Great Liang performance is subtly, dangerously wrong.
og_title: A Night at the Opera… In the Dao-Twisted World
og_description: Li Huowang is coaxed into watching a traveling opera. The songs are bold, the crowd cheers, but something about the performance doesn’t sit right.
twitter_title: Even the opera feels wrong in the Dao-Twisted World.
twitter_description: Li Huowang watches a traveling opera—and realizes the tune is off.
